rationale: All six devices were offline simultaneously while the base station showed "no_internet" uplink and a blinking red LED, pointing to a system-level network fault rather than a peripheral issue. The customer had changed internet providers and installed a new router on Monday, and the log shows "uplink lost: ethernet link down" at that time. Reconnecting the Ethernet cable to the new router and power-cycling restored the base station (solid blue LED) and brought all devices back online, confirming the root cause.

repair_steps: Confirm the base station LED is solid blue and all six devices show online in the app.
Advise the customer to keep the Ethernet cable connected to a LAN port on the new router.
Recommend checking the Garden Cam battery soon, as it was at 6% before the outage.
Close the case as resolved with root cause BS_NETWORK_DOWN (L1).
output.customer_reply: Thanks for your patience. The issue was caused by the base station losing its Ethernet connection after your new router was installed. Reconnecting the cable and power-cycling restored everything. All devices are back online now. Please keep the cable securely plugged into a LAN port on the router. Also, your Garden Cam battery was low (6%) before the outage, so you may want to charge it soon. If anything else comes up, feel free to reach out.
